what_was_done: Started and verified the local Qwen CEO runtime on port 8082 using scripts\serve_ceo_llamacpp.ps1.
Restarted the API on port 8002 with .venv Python, PYTHONPATH=src, and SUPEREZIO_EDGE_AUTH=false.
Loaded the frontend in a real Playwright browser session at http://127.0.0.1:8002/.
Loaded the AAPL 6M chart through the frontend ticker box and confirmed /api/chart-data/AAPL?timeframe=6M returned 200.
Submitted a natural-language chart question from the UI with chart_context attached.
Confirmed the backend stream returned DATA_COLLECTED, F51_VERDICT, six EXPERT_STARTED events, six EXPERT_DONE events, NEURAL_DECISION, CEO CHUNK, explanation, graph completed, and STREAM_END.
Fixed graph ordering so collect_experts runs after F51 verdict and PennyLab, removing the early experts-skipped race before CEO generation.
Fixed the frontend Experts card badge so the chart UI reports the real six expert roles as 6/6.
Ran full pytest and Ruff gates after the browser retest.
